title: Blog-Powering Agentic AI from Physical Intelligence to Assured AI Infrastructure | FMS 2026 Keynote-Silicon Motion
summary: Silicon Motion is the global leader in supplying NAND flash controllers for solid state storage devices and the merchant leader in supplying SSD controllers. We also supply customized high-performance hyperscale data center and industrial SSD solutions.
body_markdown:
[Contact Us](https://www.siliconmotion.com/support/contact/sales)


As AI expands across edge devices, vehicles, and data centers, smart storage is becoming essential to responsive experiences, reliable operation, and persistent context.


In this FMS 2026 keynote, Silicon Motion and MediaTek explore how storage supports the next wave of AI—from physical intelligence to infrastructure for collaborative AI agents.


**Stanley Huang, Associate VP of Edge SSD Business, Silicon Motion** , discusses smart storage for edge AI and the quality, safety, and security requirements of automotive and Physical AI.


**Waheed Ahmed, Director of Automotive System Architecture, MediaTek** , introduces the Dimensity Auto Cockpit vision and how generative and agentic AI are reshaping the in-vehicle experience.


**Shamil Sharief, Senior Director of Enterprise Product Marketing, Silicon Motion** , explains how next-generation PerformaShape™ within the MonTitan™ enterprise SSD platform enables workload isolation and predictable performance for multi-agent AI systems.
